# simpleaudit-docs

Documentation for simpleaudit-docs

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local audit using a pre-built scenario and a local Ollama model in under 5 minutes.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit via pip or from source, including Python version requirements and optional dependencies for local model support.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): High-level overview of the SimpleAudit components: ModelAuditor, Judges, Scenarios, and the Experiment runner.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Core concepts including adversarial probing, local-first design, multilingual support, and the judge-based evaluation methodology.
